Resolves relative Open Graph and Twitter card addresses and drops those the crawler cannot fetch

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.og_image);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.twitter_image);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.og_url);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.og_video);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.og_audio);
}
```
